summary: This filing is an 8-K by Wingstop Inc. reporting its fiscal first quarter 2026 financial results via a press release, along with disclosures of non-GAAP measures (EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted net income, Adjusted EPS). No special-situations event is present: there is no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change. The filing is a routine earnings release under Item 2.02 (Results of Operations and Financial Condition) and Item 8.01 (Other Events).
